title: How to Choose the Right Area in Alanya
excerpt: Compare central Alanya, Oba, Mahmutlar, Kestel and Kargicak through daily life, access and property profile.
content:
The right area is not defined by distance to the sea alone. Daily transport, access to health and education, street conditions, building density and seasonal activity should be considered together.

Start with intended use

A permanent home, a seasonal residence and an investment property create different priorities. Everyday services may matter most for permanent living, while site management and maintenance can be more important for occasional use.

Compare the micro-location

The coastal and hillside parts of the same district can differ in slope, noise, views and travel time. Visit at different hours and record each option in the same comparison format.

title: An Overview of the Title Deed Process in Turkey
excerpt: A general preparation checklist covering independent checks, agreements, title transfer and handover.
content:
International buyers benefit from separating the property decision from the legal, financial and technical checks. Begin with a written brief and request comparable information for every shortlisted property.

Use independent professionals

Ask appropriately licensed specialists to review property-specific documents, contracts, taxes and technical matters. The exact requirements can vary with nationality, property type and current regulation.

Plan beyond the transfer

Include insurance, utilities, keys, meter readings, management contacts and any agreed completion items in the handover checklist.

title: Budgeting for an Alanya Property Purchase
excerpt: Build a total acquisition budget rather than comparing properties by listing price alone.
content:
The advertised price is only one part of the decision. A useful budget also allows for professional advice, official charges, insurance, furnishing, utilities, site fees and an operating reserve.

Keep a current cost sheet

Rates and official requirements can change, so obtain current figures from the relevant authority and licensed professionals before committing.

Protect liquidity

A buffer for repairs, exchange-rate movement and the first months of ownership helps prevent a property decision from creating avoidable financial pressure.

title: A Practical Property Viewing Checklist
excerpt: Turn an in-person or video tour into a structured inspection covering the building, surroundings, light, sound and access.
content:
A useful viewing follows a route rather than a collection of attractive rooms. Begin outside, review the entrance and common areas, and then move through every part of the property.

Inspect practical details

Look at windows, views, storage, water points, electrical panels, finishes and signs of dampness. Review the surrounding street and nearby services.

Record unanswered questions

A viewing helps narrow the shortlist but does not replace property-specific legal or technical checks. Keep a written list for the next inspection stage.

title: Oba: Daily Life and Property Profile
excerpt: Understand why Oba is often considered by buyers seeking modern housing and access to Alanya’s everyday services.
content:
Oba combines established daily services with newer residential areas. The district can suit buyers who value access to the centre while preferring a more organised housing environment.

Street-level differences matter

Distance to main roads, the coastline and commercial activity can affect noise and walkability. Compare the exact micro-location rather than relying only on the district name.

Check the building model

Review net area, shared facilities, management arrangements and recurring fees alongside the purchase price.

title: What to Check When Buying in Mahmutlar
excerpt: A practical checklist for comparing Mahmutlar apartments by micro-location, building quality and ongoing costs.
content:
Mahmutlar offers a broad apartment market and an active coastal lifestyle, but properties can differ significantly by street, building age and distance from the main transport routes.

Compare density and sound

Visit the immediate surroundings at more than one time of day. Consider commercial activity, traffic and future construction around the building.

Review management and fees

Ask how the building or residence is managed, what the regular charges cover and whether major maintenance is planned.

title: Kargicak Villas and View Properties
excerpt: Evaluate slope, access, infrastructure and maintenance when considering a villa or hillside residence in Kargicak.
content:
Kargicak is often considered for privacy, lower density and views. Those advantages can also make vehicle access, gradient and property maintenance more important.

Inspect access in real conditions

Review road gradient, parking, drainage and travel time to everyday services. A panoramic position may have different practical implications in winter or during maintenance.

Understand ownership responsibilities

For villas and smaller compounds, clarify boundaries, shared infrastructure, pool and garden care, security and regular operating costs.

title: Why Technical and Document Checks Matter
excerpt: Prepare the building, property and document questions independent professionals should address before a commitment.
content:
Technical condition and property documents should be reviewed in relation to the exact asset and transaction. Generic assurances are not a substitute for independent, current checks.

Review the building and the asset

Ask the appointed professionals to examine the relevant ownership information, property identification, building condition and any property-specific technical concerns.

Read agreements before transferring money

Understand amounts, deadlines, conditions, default consequences and refund terms. Keep signed documents, reports and payment records together.

title: New Development or Resale Property?
excerpt: Compare completion status, specifications, location, running costs and decision risk within one framework.
content:
New developments and resale properties should be compared through the same decision criteria. Price alone does not show completion risk, condition, location quality or the cost of making the home ready.

Review what can be inspected today

For resale property, examine current condition and building records. For a development, clarify delivery stage, specifications, contractual commitments and the evidence available for the project.

Compare total cost and timing

Include furnishing, repairs, regular fees, waiting time and professional checks. Confirm property-specific risks with independent licensed advisers.

title: Choosing a Rental Home in Alanya
excerpt: Clarify term, total cost, location and contract conditions before selecting an Alanya rental.
content:
Begin with dates, intended use, household needs and transport habits. A seasonal rental and a long-term home can involve different availability, furnishing and cost structures.

Ask what the price includes

Confirm the rental period, deposit, utilities, residence fees, internet, maintenance and any service charges in writing.

Inspect the handover condition

Record furniture, appliances, keys, meter readings and existing damage when possession begins.

title: Eight Steps to Prepare a Property for Sale
excerpt: Organise documentation, condition, presentation, approved media, pricing and enquiry handling before launch.
content:
Begin with ownership information, accurate specifications and the seller's objectives. Resolve avoidable maintenance issues, organise the rooms and remove private documents before media production.

Build an accurate property file

Prepare approved photographs, plans where available, current fees, condition notes and a description that does not hide material facts or alter dimensions.

Plan launch and follow-up

Agree the pricing approach, viewing process, enquiry records and feedback cycle before publication. Update information when availability or condition changes.

title: How to Review Property Remotely
excerpt: Create a safer remote process with structured video, written evidence, independent checks and clear unanswered questions.
content:
Remote review should combine a continuous video route, written specifications and a record of what has not yet been verified. Attractive footage alone is not enough for a property decision.

Separate screening from due diligence

Use video to narrow the shortlist, then ask independent licensed professionals to complete the property-specific legal and technical checks required before commitment.

Keep an evidence file

Save current price and availability confirmation, approved media, questions, answers, professional reports and any draft agreement in one organised record.
